findings.location: architecture.md D17 (line 110) and S5 Constructors ILeafCapacityStore.Stage(LeafCapacityView(UnitId Team, ...)), ForTeam ('throws for a Team without a row, which seeding excludes')
findings.obligation: P6: Team settings payloads are byte-identical and forecasts unchanged; a Team created through POST /teams must read back its Feature WIP and throughput settings.
findings.remediation: Blocking for the S5 oracle and craft. D17 names TeamsController (create) as staging the capacity before IUnitSettings.CreateTeam, but a new Team has no id, so Stage cannot be given a UnitId, and a Team created after the seeder ran has no LeafCapacities row, so GET settings (ForTeam) throws. Counterexample: POST /teams with featureWIP 2, then GET /teams/{id}/settings: ForTeam finds no row. State the create path: for example Stage takes the capacity values without a Team id and the store keys it to the Team on the same SaveChanges (navigation fixup), or a Forecasting handler of UnitCreated writes the row from the Team columns (then say it is a second commit and that ForTeam falls back to the Team columns until it ran); add a create-then-read scenario to the S5 oracle. A one-line note that Stage's staged row is dropped with the scope on a refused save would make the 'commits neither' claim checkable.
